payload.title: Owner runs scripts/setup-npm-trusted-publishing.sh once
payload.body: One-time owner step so publish.yml can publish through npm Trusted Publishing (the v0.10.3 run 404'd on PUT: no trust rule after the repo was recreated). In a real terminal: cd ~/apps/tooling/tasks.md && git pull && npm login && bash scripts/setup-npm-trusted-publishing.sh. It is idempotent and stores no token. Then complete this task (tasks complete land-0-10-3-version-bump-and-claim-check-cli-pin); that is precondition 1 of docs/release-and-ci.md 'Autonomous release'. The old 0.10.3 bump is superseded: main is at 0.11.0.
payload.blocked: human-only — npm login needs the owner's browser 2FA in a real terminal; agents cannot do it.
